en.title: Eswatini Launches First Funded National Disability Plan, Boosting Global Accessibility Efforts
en.summary: Eswatini, with UNESCO, launched its first Costed National Disability Action Plan (2024-2028), turning disability rights into funded action. Canada also announced increased funding for skills training for youth and persons with disabilities. Meanwhile, Amazon released an adaptive display feature for Fire TV to improve living-room accessibility.

highlights.title: Eswatini launches first Costed National Disability Plan
Canada boosts skills training for youth and persons with disabilities
Amazon Launches Adaptive Display Feature for Fire TV to Create Accessible Living Room Experience
Accessibility group criticizes Metrolinx for 'stupidest ramp in the world'
Avoidable deaths fall but remain double for people with learning disabilities

zh-TW.title: 埃斯瓦蒂尼推出首個成本計算國家殘障計畫，推動全球無障礙進展
zh-TW.summary: 埃斯瓦蒂尼在聯合國教科文組織支持下，發布首個2024-2028年成本計算的國家殘首個2024-2028年成本計算的國家殘障行動計畫，將殘障權利轉為有資金支持的具體行動。加拿大同時宣布增加青年和殘障人士的技能培訓經費，亞馬遜則為Fire TV推出適應性顯示功能以改善客廳無障礙。此外，無障礙團體批評Metrolinx的坡道設計缺失電梯，而報告顯示學習障礙者可避免死亡率仍是一般人口的兩倍。
